scalars.scalar_value: Completed an accredited Physical Therapy degree program and be Board eligible and able to obtain CA PT license within 6 months or have already obtained a CA PT License. and Previous experience as a Physical Therapist or Physical Therapist intern.

items.item_text: Completed an accredited Physical Therapy degree program and be Board eligible and able to obtain CA PT license within 6 months or have already obtained a CA PT License. and Previous experience as a Physical Therapist or Physical Therapist intern.

Evaluations: Are completed according to department protocol. Completed within 24 - 48 hours once evaluation has been initiated. All relevant areas are thoroughly completed. Appropriate goals are set relative to the patient's prior level of function. Treatment plan is relevant to patient's problems identified. Patient/family participates in treatment plan and in setting goals

Provides Effective and Adequate Treatment: Implements effective and adequate treatment following department guidelines. Ongoing assessment of treatment effectiveness. Goals and treatment are modified as appropriate in relation to working toward goals. Selects appropriate treatment interventions

Patient/Family Education and Training: Addresses patient/family education. Demonstrates a variety of teaching methods. Methods are appropriate to the level of understanding. Education is timely (initiated when patient/family capable of learning) and need is identified with action taken to initiate training
Documentation: Complies with department policy regarding documentation
